name: Warp T1 and tensor
summary: Applies a given non-linear warp and affine to a T1-weighted image and to FA, MD, RD and AD tensor maps with ANTs WarpImageMultiTransform.
description: Warps the T1 and the FA, MD, RD and AD maps with ANTs WarpImageMultiTransform using the provided warp.nii.gz and affine.txt (nearest-neighbour interpolation). Use it to bring a subject's T1 and tensor maps into the space defined by a previously computed non-linear registration. The transform input must contain both the warp and the affine.

inputs.description: non-linear warp to use for warping
inputs.requirements: affine.txt must be present; the App exits otherwise.

failure_modes.message: ERROR: affine.txt not found, but has to be provided. Process terminated.
failure_modes.fix: Provide a transform dataset that includes affine.txt.
Check the log for WarpImageMultiTransform errors.
